description: BITRE Truck telematics is a dataset listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the National Freight Data Hub group, published by BITRE. BITRE have provided aggregated and deidentified telematics data on Australian roads and rest areas collected from truck operators who have collaborated in sharing data for research purposes. The data contains information from 1500 heavy vehicles. Coverage is Australia; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as continuous (live), the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2022-10-24. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is restricted or conditional according to the catalogue; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
